scope: Bind one hash-identified physical AC1024 RASTERVARIABLES frame=1 source record to a locally authored same-version wrapper, then qualify selected ASCII/Binary output, refusal/retry and typed readback. This does not qualify whole-drawing conversion or native raster behavior.

physicalWitness.provenance: ezdxf 1.4.5 authored an R2010 DXF from scratch with one LINE and RASTERVARIABLES frame=1, quality=1, units=m. ODA File Converter 27.1 produced the AC1024 DWG and a returned DXF without an .err file; the observed conversion lineage is not authenticated by hashes alone. No sample fixture was added to the repository.
physicalWitness.independentPeer: GNU LibreDWG 0.14 reports type 512, handle 0x2F, bit size 72, class/frame/quality/units 0/1/1/3, missing xdictionary and two role-4 handles, owner and reactor to physical NOD 0x0A. ezdxf observes the same scalar values in the input and ODA-returned DXFs.
physicalWitness.sourceSpan: A hash-bound source probe parses a 13-byte object frame with a 32-bit handle stream. The scalar fields end at bit 71; bit 71 is the zero string marker, followed by the owner and reactor role-4 references to 0x0A. It also verifies exactly one ACAD_IMAGE_VARS NOD entry to 0x2F. The probe uses libdxfrw page extraction, decompression and CRC verification, so those portions are not independent of the repository reader.

implementation: The physical AC1024 frame=1 selector now verifies the retained raw object frame against its revision, class, scalar values, string marker, source owner/reactor roles and NOD entry. It seeds a locally authored AC1024 wrapper with the captured values while remapping the source NOD owner/reactor 0x0A to wrapper NOD 0x0C. The prior AC1024 physical image-definition owner diagnostic remains scoped to its image-bearing frame=0 input; this LINE-only witness contains no IMAGEDEF graph.

validation.results: The physical AC1024 frame=1 selector passed. Four focused AC1024/AC1032 generated CTests passed. The selected wrapper tests ASCII/Binary invalid-value and graph-reference refusal with destination preservation, same-adapter correction/retry, and typed readback. The physical source hash was unchanged after execution.

limits: The source was locally authored and converted by one ODA version; this is not broad producer coverage.
The physical source has unrelated HEADER integrity observations. Whole-file strict export remains refused and was not qualified by the selected wrapper.
No native image rendering or downstream application behavior is established.
No DWG/DXF fixture was added; the witness remains in scratch storage.
